Subject: Surge profile + feature gating — need packaging guidance

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team and I walked away optimistic about Redwood's latency guarantees. We're close to finalizing our pilot scope, but a couple of packaging questions came up from procurement and engineering that I want to resolve before we loop Legal.

High-level ask: during Q3 we expect a baseline of 250k tokens/day with two short spikes (one-week pilots) up to 1.1M tokens/day. Procurement wants to understand options for handling surge: a) temporary burst pool (pay-as-you-go), b) prepaid credits that roll over for a quarter, or c) a committed short-term dedicated slot.

Separately, product wants a simple way to enable advanced features (function calling, streaming) for only a subset of users — ideally entitlements by user or team. Can Redwood support per-seat feature gating or do we need separate plans?

I've attached our rough Q3 projection (Elo_Usage_Projection_Q3.xlsx). Can you outline the options and any pricing delta or discount thresholds? We're on a tight procurement timeline — would like to have terms by Aug 6.

Thanks,
Raj
Head of Product, EloHealth

Attachment: Elo_Usage_Projection_Q3.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Surge profile + feature gating — need packaging guidance

Raj — thanks for the projection, that helps a lot. Quick summary up-front and then proposed options:

TL;DR: We can support all three surge models. Recommended pilot approach: prepaid quarter credits + a small on-demand burst buffer (to avoid dedicated capacity cost during short spikes). Feature gating is supported via entitlements on the private control plane; we can map features to team-level roles for your SREs/dev leads without creating separate plans.

Options we recommend for EloHealth:
- Prepaid quarter credit pool (recommended): Buy N tokens for the quarter with 10% roll-forward allowance into the next quarter. 6% discount on token rate at the volumes you listed.
- On-demand burst buffer: Metered per-token with a 15% premium over the prepaid rate. Useful for unpredictable micro-spikes.
- Short-term dedicated reservation: Blocks capacity for a week/month; best for predictable, sustained high throughput — starts at 3x the committed prepaid cost.

Feature entitlements:
- Role-based entitlements (no plan split): We can gate function-calling/streaming per team and trace usage separately.
- If you need billing separation per business unit, we can create sub-accounts with separate billing but recommend entitlements first to keep things simple.

I'll put together a short pricing sketch and a mutual action plan. Do you have a preferred SLA tier? Also looping Ben (AE) to confirm discount levers.

Best,
Sofia
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-surge-credit-options.pdf (pdf)

Raj — quick note on pricing levers we can pull:

1) Committed quarterly credit (your baseline): ~6% discount at your projected volumes (250k tokens/day).
2) If you commit to a 6-month reserved pool (minimum), we can increase to a 12% discount and include a 20% buffer of prepaid credits for burst protection.
3) For the short-term dedicated reservation (one-week or one-month), markup vs prepaid is ~3x in cost but delivers hard throughput guarantees.
4) We can include a limited rollover policy (10% of unused prepaid tokens roll forward one quarter) in the MSA; anything beyond requires an addendum.

Two clarifications I need from your procurement team:
- Do you require credits to be refundable or fully transferable between sub-accounts?
- Is there an internal requirement to have feature usage appear on separate invoices?

If procurement signs off on non-transferable credits + consolidated billing, I can push for a one-time strategic discount of 4% (applied to your first quarter) tied to a 6-month commit. Let me know and I will draft the commercial term sheet.

— Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Mutual action plan (pilot)

- Baseline prepaid credits: 22M tokens for the quarter (covers 250k tokens/day baseline).
- Roll-forward: 15% of unused prepaid tokens roll into the next quarter (agreed for pilot only).
- Burst coverage: On-demand metered buffer at 1.15x prepaid rate.
- Feature entitlements: Role-based gating enabled; per-team usage export via API (daily CSV available).
- Transferability: Credits can be transferred across EloHealth sub-accounts for billing purposes (subject to audit logs).
- Discount: 8% off list token rate for the quarter (pilot-only strategic discount).
- Acceptance path: Procurement confirms by Aug 6; Legal completes MSA signature by Aug 13; pilot start Aug 16.
